normal.notes: Fixes a bug that could make this Mac show as “offline” on your iPhone even while it was awake and sharing — presence is no longer tied to which screen the app is showing. Sharing now also resumes by itself after a restart, crash or update, so a Mac you left shared stays reachable. Please update.

beta.notes: Presence moved out of the host view's lifecycle (heartbeats no longer stop when you navigate Back while sharing) + sharing resumes after any relaunch.
